Cadastral map of several oil-prospecting townships in McKean County (Pa.) between Kane and Bradford cities.

Cadastral map of several oil-prospecting townships in McKean County (Pa.) between Kane and Bradford cities. Shows real-property lines, landowners' names (personal/corporate), tract/lot numbers, warrant section numbers, and some acreages. Also shows roads, railroad, and pipeline. Originally printed on 2 sheets (later conjoined, still later halved along a different line to enable folding). Includes bar "Scale of rods".
